audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-3].side and phases[5,6].side read "Skill" while content win[] says Seraphine for 0-3 and Sivir for 5-6. phases[4] already agrees (both Skill).
audit.why: Seraphine's 900-range Q outranges Sivir's early autos and Sivir's mana pool can't sustain a poke war until level 6, but once Sivir completes an item her Spellblade-empowered Q waveclears and Spell Shield eats Seraphine's poke, and On The Hunt lets her kite Encore in fights.
audit.corrected: phases[0-3].side -> Seraphine, phases[5,6].side -> Sivir; ratings/whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns calls Spell Shield matchup-defining with no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Spell Shield (E) is 24-18s by rank and Boomerang Blade (Q) is 10-8s. Naming both lets a reader time the bait-and-poke window instead of a vague 'check it before every step-up'.

Spell Shield eating a single targeted ability is already correctly the matchup's focus interaction throughout dos/breakdown/report. missingInteractions flags that Spell Shield also creates terrain that blocks paths/dashes, cutting off retreat — not currently stated anywhere and Seraphine has no dash of her own to answer it.
audit.corrected: Left for follow-up; no field could absorb it within the length band without displacing an existing, already-correct point.
